summary: This bill amends section 309 of the Clean Air Act to restrict EPA review and written comments to proposed legislation only, by removing all requirements to review or comment on federal construction projects, major agency actions, and proposed regulations from other agencies.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly reduces environmental review requirements for federal projects and regulations by removing EPA's review and comment authority under the Clean Air Act for actions already subject to NEPA. This is a central aspect of the bill, aiming to lessen environmental regulations.
